title: NOA 46 Motor Yacht Set to Debut at Cannes Yachting Festival 2023
description: Discover the NOA 46, a luxurious 46-meter motor yacht by The Yacht Factory, debuting at the Cannes Yachting Festival this September.
html:
Overview of the NOA 46

The NOA 46, a 46-meter motor yacht built by The Yacht Factory in Yalova, Turkey, will make its official debut at the Cannes Yachting Festival, taking place from 9 to 14 September. Ocean Independence has been appointed as the Central Agent for this yacht.

Design and Guest Accommodation

Hot Lab Yacht Design is behind both the exterior and interior styling of the NOA 46. Designed for long-range voyages, the yacht features a steel hull paired with an aluminium superstructure, meeting RINA and MCA class requirements. The vessel accommodates up to ten guests in five staterooms. The main salon connects seamlessly to an outdoor lounge that boasts a generous jacuzzi. On the sundeck, guests will find a DJ booth, bar, and gym zone, offering a variety of leisure options.

Interiors and Technical Details

The interior scheme incorporates shades of brown and beige, enhanced by large windows that fill the space with natural light. Propulsion comes from twin MAN 1,450HP engines that meet IMO Tier III standards. The yacht has a range of 4,000 nautical miles at a 10-knot pace, cruises at 13 knots, and reaches a top speed of 15.7 knots. ABT TRAC fin stabilisers deliver comfort underway and while anchored. Navigation is supported by Simrad technology.

Shipyard Facilities

The Yacht Factory operates from a 200,000-square-meter premises, featuring a floating dock for sizable vessels and a travel lift with an 800-ton lifting capacity, enabling the construction and servicing of superyachts like the NOA 46.
